{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Hoback Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Merna, Wyoming to Jackson, Wyoming.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://present5.com/lower-valley-energy-natural-gas-pipeline-update-hoback/|title=present5.com|website=present5.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
